description_en: Updates a model or processor of a service. If only the metadata.instance field is updated, manual scaling can be performed
description_zh: 用于服务的模型或Processor更新。如果只更新metadata.instance字段，则用于服务扩缩容功能
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateService

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the service
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service update. Valid values: merge and replace. By default, merge is used if you do not specify this parameter.

merge: If the JSON string configured for the existing service is `{"a":"b"}` and the JSON string specified in the body parameter is `{"c":"d"}`, the JSON string is `{"a":"b","c":"d"}` after the service update.
replace: If the JSON string configured for the existing service is `{"a":"b"}` and the JSON string specified in the body parameter is `{"c":"d"}`, the JSON string is `{"c":"d"}` after the service update
parameters.help_zh:
服务更新类型，目前支持合并模式和替换模式。不传默认为合并模式。

merge（合并模式）：若原服务配置JSON为
`{"a":"b"}`，更新配置为`{"c":"d"}` ，则合并模式下最终配置为`{"a":"b","c":"d"}`。
replace（替换模式）：若原服务配置JSON为
`{"a":"b"}`，更新配置为`{"c":"d"}` ，则替换模式下最终配置为`{"c":"d"}`
parameters.name: update_type

parameters.help_en: The request body. The body includes the request parameters that you want to update. For more information about the request parameters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412086.html
parameters.help_zh: 更新配置。参数配置说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412086.html
parameters.name: body

Message.example: Succeed to update service [foo] in region [cn-shanghai]
